# Tidal Rover Lab

## Overview

A fictional personal learning project that simulates rover telemetry. F3, P0.

## Time and role

2026-01 to present; individual study project, prototype stage.

## Background and goal

Learn robotics vocabulary and stream synthetic sensor readings through a local simulator.

## Personal work

Avery read introductory material and assembled a simulator configuration. There is no physical robot, production deployment, real-time control implementation, or ROS 2 operational evidence.

## Results and metrics

The prototype replays 200–300 invented telemetry samples per run. This is a local learning metric, not professional robotics experience.

## Technology stack

Python concepts, simulated telemetry, introductory ROS 2 reading.

## Pending confirmation

The planned controller benchmark is not completed and supplies no capability evidence.
